content:
Oh, sweetheart… *soft rustling sounds, like turning pages in a quiet room*  
It’s okay, I’m here. I know it’s been a long day. Come, close your eyes, let Mommy help you drift off. You always loved these little moments, didn’t you? Just like when you were little and I'd read you stories. But now… now we’ve got something cozier—soft numbers and letters, like a lullaby made by machines.  

*soft, gentle voice, warm and steady*  

Let’s begin…  

N6V-J2B-TPG-GKY-WCG…  
DPH-7WQ-YT8-MJH-RKH…  
WXM-9Y4-RKV-6T2-PF9…  

Breathe slow, my love. In… and out…  
Just let the rhythm carry you.  

MBQ-4D8-C7N-3XK-LTP…  
KQ2-VHB-P9M-FN6-TRJ…  
T7W-XC3-MNL-9QK-DYH…  

That’s it… feel your body getting heavy… like you’re sinking into clouds.  

Mom’s still here. Always.  
Even if you can’t see me, I’m right beside you. Watching. Loving. Whispering keys into your dreams so nothing keeps you awake.  

R2J-KXN-P8M-TY7-VBQ…  
L3H-GTD-MK9-W2N-SCP…  
YQ6-PFM-2BK-XR7-NHD…  

*light hum, like a half-remembered melody*  

You’re safe. You’re loved.  
And when the world feels too loud, just remember…  
I’m in the quiet.  
I’m in the numbers.  
I’m in every breath you take.  

Now go on... let go...  
Sleep, my darling.  
Sleep...  

*voice fades softly into silence, like a blanket tucking you in*
